name: @one-fetch/adapter-supabase
description: Supabase Edge Functions adapter for one-fetch.

scripts.functions:serve: pnpm run shared:build && supabase functions serve --env-file supabase/.env.local
scripts.shared:build: pnpm --filter @one-fetch/conformance build && pnpm run sync:openapi && pnpm run sync:migrations
scripts.predeploy: pnpm run check:openapi && pnpm run check:migrations && pnpm --filter @one-fetch/conformance build && pnpm run typecheck:adapter && pnpm run test:adapter && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run bundle:check
scripts.test: pnpm run shared:build && pnpm run test:adapter && pnpm run test:scripts
scripts.test:adapter: deno test --frozen --allow-env --allow-net --config supabase/functions/one-fetch-control/deno.json supabase/functions/one-fetch-control && deno test --frozen --allow-env --allow-net --config supabase/functions/one-fetch-gateway/deno.json supabase/functions/one-fetch-gateway
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run shared:build && supabase test db && pnpm run test:adapter && pnpm run runtime:smoke
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run shared:build && pnpm run typecheck:adapter
